messages.text: Good news team! TechSupply came through with expedited customs clearance.
Oh that's great! What's the new timeline?
They arranged a partial shipment with priority handling. We will get the HB900 driver by October 14th now.
That's much better than November 7th! Should we let avionics know?
Yes, please notify them. This should help with the Q3 integration test timeline.
